config.label: GraphQL endpoint URL used for executing queries and mutations
config.description: GraphQL endpoint URL used for executing queries and mutations. Defaults to the public Countries API.

config.label: GraphQL endpoint URL used for schema introspection
config.description: GraphQL endpoint URL used for schema introspection. Defaults to GRAPHQL_API_URL.

config.label: Bearer token for authenticating query and mutation execution
config.description: Bearer token for authenticating query and mutation execution.

config.label: Bearer token for schema introspection
config.description: Bearer token for schema introspection. Defaults to GRAPHQL_TOKEN.

config.label: Maximum number of generated query and mutation tools
config.description: Maximum number of generated query and mutation tools. Defaults to 128.

config.label: Set to false to disable mutation tools and mutation execution
config.description: Set to false to disable mutation tools and mutation execution. Defaults to true.

config.label: Retries for transient upstream responses
config.description: Retries for transient upstream responses. Defaults to 0.
